                                  ANIMAL
                                  SHLTR
METHODOLOGY & CONVENTIONS

  This proposal is calculated and presented by addressing sheltering
service deliverables as required by the City of Cheyenne and Laramie
County service contract. This methodology results in a valuation of the cost
to ensure care and safety of people and animals community wide.

 The proposal is based on fiscal year 2024 financial figures and allows
direct alignment of costs to animal intake jurisdictional allocations as
requested in quarterly contract reporting.

Modeling a future cost for contract services based on past expense figures
produces a lower cost to government agencies.

• The proposal makes a clear distinction between the cost of sheltering
services and those of other services and activities provided by CAS. It
therefore eliminates any concern about the use of public funding for other
non-profit, mission-driven programming provided by the organization that is
outside the scope of sheltering services.

• Future use of this cost-recovery model will utilize data from first a two,
and then a three-year rolling average of actual expenses. This will provide
an even distribution of trends, helping to cushion any extreme
circumstances that may dramatically change the contract year-to-year. In
doing so, we eliminate reliance on projections. Due to the nature of the
data collection and allocation, pre-2024 data is not available for use in this
first year.
